name: Tsumi to Batsu
source:
A shocking sight witnessed by young elite judge Matsuoka Masayoshi .... 
It was a sacred court cellar and a girl was insulted in it.
From this day his life went mad. Strange cases passed by mysterious man and sometimes even innocent girls awaiting insulting punishment. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-october-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
年轻的精英法官松冈正义亲眼目睹了令人震惊的一幕…… 
这是一个神圣的宫廷地窖，一个女孩在里面受到了侮辱。
从这一天起，他的生活变得疯狂。奇怪的案件发生在神秘男子身上，有时甚至还有等待侮辱性惩罚的无辜女孩。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-october-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
